The JSON data is about the digital art named "Trails of Yakshagana" created by artist Sarwesh Shah. This artistic creation is unique as it captures the essence of a solo Yakshagana performance, a regional dance form from the Dakshina Kannada district in coastal Karnataka. Sarwesh incorporated the power of a graphical processing unit in a computer to create a motion trail of this performance. The artist describes his work as a "moving sculpture" where a Yakshagana dance video is used as input to generate a 2D puppetry animation mimicking the movements of the dancer. 

Sarwesh aims to convey the richness, playfulness, and ephemeral nature of Yakshagana in this digital art piece as it enhances viewers' feelings by amplifying visual elements like movements, color, and motion blur. The artwork focuses on the body language and expressions of the dancer, depicting a combination of Shanta and Adbhuta Rasa, and avoiding overly bright colors to ensure comfort for viewers.

The artist was inspired by Karnataka's legendary painter K.K. Hebbar, Yakshagana practitioners, the Futurist Art Movement of the West, and artists Giacomo Balla and Marcel Duchamp. Sarwesh hopes his art would kindle interest in Yakshagana, especially for newcomers in the city of Bengaluru.
